name: Frame-Guard
description: Frame-Guard Android overlay with collision hitboxes, approximate forward trajectory projection, player bounds, FPS, and input timing telemetry.

show-hitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Draw collision outlines for supported gameplay objects, including oriented boxes, circles, slopes, portals, pads, and rings; decorative objects are filtered out.

show-trajectory.name: Show trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Project an approximate future path from current velocity and held input; future collisions and triggers are not simulated.

show-player-bounds.name: Show player bounds
show-player-bounds.description: Show the current player collision boxes for player 1 and player 2.

show-fps.name: Show FPS counter
show-fps.description: Show a lightweight FPS estimate based on PlayLayer update delta time.

frameguard-enabled.name: Enable FrameGuard telemetry
frameguard-enabled.description: Record input press/release edges with monotonic timestamps and current level-update frame. Does not alter gameplay.

show-frameguard-hud.name: Show FrameGuard HUD
show-frameguard-hud.description: Display frame counter, input count, and last input timing on screen.

toggle-menu.name: Toggle Frame-Guard menu
toggle-menu.description: Toggle the floating Frame-Guard menu with the F key.
